verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents a dedicated API Sandbox for testing integrations without affecting the live account or real funds. It runs on its own host (api-sandbox.dynadot.com) with separate sandbox keys and a pre-funded test balance, and it also covers the legacy v3 API. missing for 10: full command parity (the vendor says some commands are unavailable or behave differently in the sandbox), any evidence that the MCP server can target the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Dynadot API Sandbox environment allows you to safely test your API integrations without affecting your live account or real funds
pre-funded with a balance of 10,000 in all supported currencies for testing purposes
